title.narrative: EXPLORING CHISINAU AS PLACE FOR DANISH-UKRAINIAN COLLABORATION

description.narrative: This preparatory study aims to renew the partnership between Radikal Ungdom (RU) and Liberal Democratic League of Ukraine (LDLU) through collaborative workshops. The goal is to prepare for a larger seminar on countering Russian misinformation and addressing Ukraine's security challenges.Through writing workshops and meetings with LDLU's board and project teams, we will develop a joint project application. The study will establish objectives and implementation strategies for the main seminar. We also plan to explore including Moldovan participants, as they face similar misinformation and security challenges. This multi-national approach will strengthen regional cooperation in addressing these issues.
